title: Choosing 4 balls from 5 red and 7 blue
caption: The 495 equally likely choices split by number of reds as 35, 175, 210, 70, 5. Exactly 2 red: 210/495 = 14/33.
alt: Bar chart of the number of the 495 ways to choose 4 balls that contain 0 to 4 red: 35, 175, 210, 70, 5; the bar for 2 is highlighted.
description: There are C(12, 4) = 495 ways to choose 4 balls.
With k red, there are C(5, k) × C(7, 4 − k) ways: 35, 175, 210, 70, 5.
